description: Turn a request in words into a Sell to State search: terms in the languages of the countries, and filters (scope, country, lifecycle, date window, amounts). Example text: 'body-worn cameras for police in Kenya and South Africa, open tenders'. Returns {summary, scope, q, filters, url, count, notes}; call `search` with scope, q and the filters to get the rows. When the text names nothing to search, returns {answer} only. Uses the daily AI search limit (3 a day for free accounts, 100 with a plan).
